platform: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, profile AOT, native canvas
protocol: A1/B1/B2/A2. 800ms warmup, seven 200ms batches; reverse case order for B2/A2. Separate production and prototype binaries, mode-0 controls inside prototype. No builds/tests during timing. Full CPU sums phase medians per process then averages the two processes.
profile: Three production-baseline CPU captures, five seconds after VM-service connection then ten seconds of cleared samples. CPU samples include simulation/data writes that phase timers exclude.
normalization: Scene data changes are outside phase timers for both full and data-only cases. The local harness calls change before frame cases too. All cases retain every item.
